newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aerospace sees progress in spinoff.
newsitem.headline: China Aerospace sees progress in spinoff.

text.p: China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd said on Friday the Hong Kong stock exchange had approved in principle the company's application of a proposed spinoff of its telecommunications equipment maker.
"The stock exchange has notified the company that the listing committee has approved in principle the application in relation to the proposed listing," the electronics maker said in a statement.
"The proposed listing is still subject to the final approval by the listing committee of the stock exchange."
China Aerospace said an announcement would be made when the final details of the proposed offering had been finalised and approved by the stock exchange.
The company proposed to spin off its telecommunications equipment manufacturing and global positioning systems operations through a separate listing of a newly formed subsidiary.
